controls.comment: Good translation of this page, but it adds a sentence from the next page.
Accurate otherwise, but it leaves out a full sentence of the argument.
Ends with text from the next page and garbles Ning's verdict and the editorial mark.
Drops the clause about lifting the corpse, misreads 案 as a table and garbles the romanization of 稽顙.
Leaves out the father/son status sentence and reverses who accepts what is good in the first passage.
